description: Predicts the instruction you'll type next after each finished turn and shows it above the composer, one key from your draft. Press Tab or → in the empty composer, or click the line, to put it in your draft; nothing is sent for you. Choose the model with bb's provider and model picker: Claude Code and Codex models run as one CLI call with no tools, and any other provider runs as a hidden worker thread. Only the thread's user and assistant messages are sent, never tool output, and hidden and child threads are skipped. Each suggestion is one request on a provider you already use; the default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, needs the claude CLI signed in on the bb server.
